name: obsidian-symbat
description: Integrates the Numbat scientific calculator into your notes, with comprehensive tooling.
author: Ara Adkins
//scripts: `build` deliberately does not chain `build:wasm`. That script needs a Rust
toolchain, a version-matched wasm-bindgen and binaryen; `npm run build` has
to work with none of them, because that is what Obsidian's plugin review
runs against a clean checkout. The generated bindings are committed instead
(see .gitignore), and `make wasm` regenerates them when NUMBAT_TAG moves.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

//overrides: Every @codemirror/* package is an esbuild `external`: Obsidian supplies one
copy of each at runtime, at the versions it pins as peer dependencies. Some
transitive dependents ask for newer, and npm would satisfy that by nesting a
second copy — which type-checks the plugin against APIs that will not be
there. Forcing the tree flat keeps the types honest about what ships.
